visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long wavy brown hair and light makeup stands in front of a mirror in a bedroom. She wears a white crew-neck T-shirt and blue denim jeans. The room is brightly lit. In her mirror reflection, she touches her shoulders and adjusts her shirt while looking at her silhouette. Polaroids are stuck to the mirror frame, and a clothes rack is partially visible in the background. (2) The scene shifts to the woman wearing a black underwire bra under a very cropped, white, long-sleeved knit cardigan. She is dancing energetically against a plain white wall, demonstrating how the bra moves when she raises her arms. She points at the gap in the bra cups with a frustrated expression. Yellow and white variety text overlays appear dynamically. (3) The character switches to a navy blue lace bra, performing the same movements to show stability. A close-up shot of the bra lying on a bed highlights the interior mesh design and lace texture. She smiles and poses confidently, raising her arms high without the bra shifting. (4) In a fitting room setting with a yellow curtain, the woman wears a tight grey long-sleeved top over a pink bra. She looks dissatisfied, pointing at visible bumps on her chest through the fabric. She then transitions to wearing a smooth white shirt over the same pink bra, showcasing a streamlined silhouette while posing. (5) Sitting in a living room near a white electric floor fan, the woman wears a camouflage mesh hooded top over a black sports-style bra. She appears hot and wipes sweat from her forehead. She adjusts the bra strap and demonstrates its breathability and fabric texture. (6) In the final scene, she sits on a grey sofa, holding all three bra styles (navy, pink, black) and talking directly to the camera. Promotional text with a discount code appears at the bottom.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long, wavy hair dyed with blue/brown highlights, wearing a white tee, cropped cardigan, grey top, and white shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A bedroom with a mirror and clothes rack; a plain white wall for dancing; a fitting room with yellow curtains; and a living room with a sofa and an electric fan.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice narrates in Mandarin over an upbeat electronic dance BGM. The music features bright synth pads and a consistent 4/4 electronic drum beat. Speech is fast and clear. (2) A 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the speaker's vocal arousal increases to show excitement. Rhythmic percussion hits sync with the speaker's emphasis on the 'three saviors.' (3) Periodic 'ding' SFX are heard as text overlays appear. The BGM remains steady, while the vocal tone shifts between playful frustration when describing fit issues and triumphant satisfaction. (4) During the product close-up, the voice remains energetic but more descriptive. In the camo top segment, a faint mechanical hum from a fan is audibly layered beneath the music and speech. (5) The video concludes with the speaker providing a strong call to action, accompanied by a final bright stinger SFX and the BGM fading out slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution 1 -> Solution 2 -> Solution 3 -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and review a new series of bras specifically designed for 'L-sized' women, highlighting three functional types for different needs: anti-shake, slimming, and breathable.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of products, specific product names in slogans, and a discount code 'done85'.
